title: Docking station not working
symptom: Nothing connected to the docking station works
user_description: I put my laptop on the docking station like always, but the monitors, keyboard and mouse are all dead.

options.why: Wasteful. The laptop works on its own, and nothing points to it as the cause.

options.text: Tell him to plug everything directly into the laptop and close the ticket
options.why: A workaround, not a fix. The dock is a company asset that should be diagnosed, and the user loses the dock setup.

options.text: Check the dock's own power adapter and light, reseat the cable to the laptop, and test with another cable or port before suspecting drivers or firmware
options.why: A dock is a small hub that needs its own power and a good connection. Checking power, the cable and then software in order finds the cause with the least effort.
Never the first step. It would not help if the dock has no power or a loose cable.

hints: Does the dock have its own power, and is its light on?
What is the one cable that links everything on the dock to the laptop?
If hardware checks pass, what software might the dock depend on?
real_world_tip: If a spare dock is available, swapping it in is the fastest way to prove whether the dock or the laptop is at fault.
